_meta.description: Tier 2 — IFRS 15 / ASC 606 five-step revenue recognition. Adds eleven new schemas (RevenueContract, PerformanceObligation, TransactionPrice, PriceAllocation, RevenueRecognitionEvent, ContractAsset, ContractLiability, ContractModification, VariableConsiderationAdjustment, ContractCostAsset, RevenueWaterfall) implementing the five-step model: (1) identify the contract, (2) identify separate performance obligations, (3) determine the transaction price, (4) allocate the price across POs using relative stand-alone selling price (SSP), (5) recognise revenue when/as each PO is satisfied (REQ-IFRS15-001..011). RevenueContract is named to avoid colliding with contract-lifecycle-management's generic Contract schema, the fleet's canonical ADR-051 ns#Contract implementer (contracts-single-home); the two are deliberately separate registers for separate bounded contexts and MUST NOT be merged, aliased, or share a slug. RevenueContract carries an x-openregister-lifecycle (draft -> signed -> in-delivery -> completed / cancelled); posting a RevenueRecognitionEvent materialises a balanced GLTransaction via the T1 materialisation extension (debit accrued-revenue / credit revenue, REQ-IFRS15-007). RevenueWaterfall declares an x-openregister-aggregations block documenting the per-contract, per-period roll-up of recognised + remaining transaction price for 60+ months (REQ-IFRS15-008). The nightly contract asset/liability cut-off (idempotent reverse-then-post), the relative-SSP / residual price allocation, the cost-to-cost percentage-of-completion, and the variable-consideration constraint + re-estimation are computed by OCA\Shillinq\Service\RevenueCutoffService + RevenueRecognitionCalculator + VariableConsiderationReestimationService via the real OpenRegister ObjectService API (find / findAll / saveObject), with the declarative shapes documented on the schemas per ADR-031. ContractAsset / ContractLiability / RevenueWaterfall are read-only (derived nightly, never authored by operators). Seed objects provide the four worked examples from design.md (36-month SaaS bundle, cost-to-cost construction, multi-year maintenance with escalation, distinct-scope modification = new contract).

RevenueContract.title: Revenue Contract
RevenueContract.description: A customer revenue contract under IFRS 15 — the legal instrument that bundles one or more performance obligations (REQ-IFRS15-001). Named RevenueContract (not the bare Contract) specifically to avoid colliding with contract-lifecycle-management's generic Contract schema, which is the fleet's canonical ADR-051 ns#Contract implementer; the two are deliberately separate registers for separate bounded contexts (revenue recognition vs. generic contract lifecycle) and MUST NOT be merged, aliased, or share a slug (contracts-single-home). Carries identification, dates, the decomposed transaction price (fixed + estimated variable), currency, the signed-at date, the originating quote/order reference, and a contractGroupId for IFRS 15.17 combination-of-contracts treatment (REQ-IFRS15-011). Revenue contracts are first-class entities with their own lifecycle and modification history; they are never embedded in GL transactions or invoice rows.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: IFRS 15 revenue-recognition records MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — every change feeds the IFRS 15.116-119 contract-balance reconciliation, the IFRS 15.120 RPO disclosure, and the variable-consideration constraint trail that auditors review per IFRS 15.123-126 significant-judgements disclosure.

customerName.title: Customer Name

quoteOrderReference.description: FK to the originating SalesOrder / Quote (bookkeeping-quote-order-invoice); the contract is the same legal instrument as the order (REQ-IFRS15-001).
quoteOrderReference.title: Quote Order Reference

contractGroupId.title: Contract Group ID

signedAt.description: Date the contract was signed and an enforceable right/obligation arose (IFRS 15.9).
signedAt.title: Signed At

endDate.description: Expected date all performance obligations complete.
endDate.title: End Date

fixedConsideration.description: Guaranteed (fixed) consideration component of the total transaction price (REQ-IFRS15-002).
fixedConsideration.title: Fixed Consideration

variableConsideration.description: Estimated variable consideration (rebates, usage, bonuses) before constraint; constrained amount lives on TransactionPrice (REQ-IFRS15-002, REQ-IFRS15-003).
variableConsideration.title: Variable Consideration

modificationHistory.description: Ordered list of ContractModification slugs applied to this contract (REQ-IFRS15-006); the authoritative records are ContractModification entities, this is a denormalised pointer list for the audit timeline.
modificationHistory.title: Modification History

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads are scoped to the requesting user's administration (REQ-IFRS15-007 / ADR-005 IDOR-safety).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

sign.description: Contract is signed; the transaction price is locked and price allocation across POs is computed once (REQ-IFRS15-004).

beginDelivery.description: Performance begins; RevenueRecognitionEvents may now be posted against the contract's POs.

complete.description: All performance obligations satisfied; remaining transaction price is zero.

cancel.description: Contract cancelled; no further recognition; any contract liability is settled/refunded per the cancellation terms.

PerformanceObligation.title: Performance Obligation
PerformanceObligation.description: A distinct promised good or service within a contract (IFRS 15.22-30, REQ-IFRS15-005). Carries the satisfaction pattern (point-in-time | over-time) and, for over-time POs, the output method (units-delivered, milestones, time-elapsed, percentage-of-completion) or input method (cost-to-cost, labour-hours, machine-hours, units-produced). For cost-to-cost it sources actual + estimated cost from the project-accounting module (costBasis FK) and derives percentageComplete = actualCostToDate / revisedTotalEstimatedCost (REQ-IFRS15-005). Holds the stand-alone selling price (SSP) used for relative allocation and the resulting allocated price.

satisfactionPattern.title: Satisfaction Pattern

inputMethod.title: Input Method

costBasis.title: Cost Basis

estimatedTotalCost.description: Original estimated total cost for an input-method PO (REQ-IFRS15-005).
estimatedTotalCost.title: Estimated Total Cost

actualCostToDate.description: Cumulative actual cost incurred to date, sourced from the project module (REQ-IFRS15-005).
actualCostToDate.title: Actual Cost To Date

revisedTotalEstimatedCost.title: Revised Total Estimated Cost

allocatedPrice.title: Allocated Price

statusAtPeriodEnd.title: Status At Period End

TransactionPrice.title: Transaction Price
TransactionPrice.description: The decomposed transaction price of a contract (IFRS 15.46-72, REQ-IFRS15-002). Splits the price into fixed consideration, estimated variable consideration (with estimation method and the IFRS 15.56 constraint), significant-financing-component adjustment (payment timing > 12 months), non-cash consideration at fair value, and consideration payable to the customer (a price reduction). Total = fixed + min(variable, constraint) + financing + nonCash - payableToCustomer.

variableConsideration.description: Unconstrained estimate for rebates, discounts, bonuses, refunds (REQ-IFRS15-002).
variableConsideration.title: Variable Consideration

estimationMethod.description: Method of estimating variable consideration (IFRS 15.53): expected value or most-likely amount (REQ-IFRS15-003).
estimationMethod.title: Estimation Method

constraintAmount.description: Variable consideration limited to the amount highly probable not to reverse (IFRS 15.56, REQ-IFRS15-003). The constrained amount, not the raw estimate, enters the total.
constraintAmount.title: Constraint Amount

constraintReason.description: Documented justification for the constraint level (market volatility, return rates, etc.), auditable in the disclosure pack (REQ-IFRS15-003).
constraintReason.title: Constraint Reason

significantFinancingComponent.description: Adjustment for the time value of money when payment timing exceeds 12 months (IFRS 15.60-62, REQ-IFRS15-002).
significantFinancingComponent.title: Significant Financing Component

nonCashConsideration.description: Fair value of non-cash consideration (equity, goods, future discounts) (IFRS 15.66-69).
nonCashConsideration.title: Non Cash Consideration

considerationPayableToCustomer.description: Amounts payable to the customer, treated as a reduction of the transaction price (IFRS 15.70-72, REQ-IFRS15-002).
considerationPayableToCustomer.title: Consideration Payable To Customer

effectiveDate.description: Date this transaction-price composition takes effect (a modification creates a new effective-dated record).
effectiveDate.title: Effective Date

PriceAllocation.title: Price Allocation
PriceAllocation.description: The per-PO allocation of the total transaction price (IFRS 15.73-90, REQ-IFRS15-004). Default method is relative stand-alone selling price (allocatedAmount[i] = SSP[i] / sum(SSP) * totalPrice); the residual method applies when one PO's SSP is highly uncertain. Stored per PO (not derived each time) to preserve the original allocation intent for audit; recalculated on modification or material constraint change.

RevenueRecognitionEvent.title: Revenue Recognition Event
RevenueRecognitionEvent.description: Evidence that a performance obligation moved toward satisfaction in a period (REQ-IFRS15-005, REQ-IFRS15-007). Records the recognised amount, the basis (units delivered, % complete, milestone), and the supporting evidence (delivery note, timesheet, sign-off). Posting a RevenueRecognitionEvent materialises exactly one balanced GLTransaction (debit accrued-revenue / credit revenue) via the T1 materialisation extension, linked by glTransactionId.

basisDescription.title: Basis Description

glTransactionId.description: FK to the GLTransaction materialised when this event posted (REQ-IFRS15-007); set by the materialisation, read-only thereafter.
glTransactionId.title: GL Transaction ID

recognitionGlPosting.description: Posting a RevenueRecognitionEvent materialises exactly one balanced GLTransaction via the T1 materialisation extension (REQ-IFRS15-007): debit the accrued-revenue control account and credit the revenue account for recognisedAmount. RevenueCutoffService is the engine-side writer when the declarative materialisation engine cannot resolve the cross-schema control-account lookup; it writes through the real OpenRegister ObjectService saveObject API and stores the resulting GLTransaction id back onto glTransactionId.

ContractAsset.title: Contract Asset
ContractAsset.description: Read-only, derived nightly per contract (IFRS 15.116-119, REQ-IFRS15-007). A contract asset is the entity's right to consideration when cumulative recognised revenue exceeds cumulative billed amount. Never authored by operators; recalculated by the idempotent nightly cut-off and posted to the accrued-revenue control account.

ContractLiability.title: Contract Liability
ContractLiability.description: Read-only, derived nightly per contract (IFRS 15.116-119, REQ-IFRS15-007). A contract liability (deferred revenue) is the obligation to transfer goods/services for which the entity has already been paid/billed, when cumulative billed exceeds cumulative recognised. Never authored by operators; recalculated by the idempotent nightly cut-off and posted to the deferred-revenue control account.

ContractModification.title: Contract Modification
ContractModification.description: An amendment to a contract, recorded as a separate entity (never an inline edit) and classified per IFRS 15.18-21 (REQ-IFRS15-006): new-contract (distinct goods/services at SSP), not-distinct-cumulative (combine + catch-up), or prospective (price-only). Carries before/after snapshots for audit and the new transaction price. Classification may be auto-proposed and overridden with a documented reason.

VariableConsiderationAdjustment.title: Variable Consideration Adjustment
VariableConsiderationAdjustment.description: A periodic re-estimation of variable consideration (rebates, refunds, bonuses, penalties, volume discounts) per IFRS 15.50-58 (REQ-IFRS15-003). Each entry records the prior and new constrained estimate, the constraint reason, the delta, the operator who recorded it, and the GLTransaction posted to recognise additional revenue (delta > 0) or reverse revenue (delta < 0).

ContractCostAsset.title: Contract Cost Asset
ContractCostAsset.description: Incremental costs to obtain (sales commission, proposal costs) or fulfil (setup, customisation) a contract, capitalised when the IFRS 15.91-95 criteria are met (REQ-IFRS15-009). Amortised on the same pattern as the related PO satisfaction and tested for impairment each reporting date; if the contract becomes onerous the carried amount is written down with a GL posting.

RevenueWaterfall.title: Revenue Waterfall
RevenueWaterfall.description: Read-only per-contract, per-period time series of the transaction price flowing into recognised revenue (IFRS 15.120 remaining-performance-obligation disclosure, REQ-IFRS15-008). Stores allocated price, prior cumulative, period recognised, cumulative recognised, remaining amount, remaining months, and the deferred-liability / accrual-asset split. Aggregatable by customer, segment, and consolidated; forecast forward 60+ months. Derived nightly after the cut-off; never authored by operators.

priorCumulativeRecognised.title: Prior Cumulative Recognised

periodRecognised.title: Period Recognised

remainingMonths.description: Estimated months until all POs complete; for contracts beyond 60 months a tail bucket aggregates years 6+ (REQ-IFRS15-008).
remainingMonths.title: Remaining Months

deferredLiability.description: Amount billed but not yet recognised (contract liability) at period end.
deferredLiability.title: Deferred Liability

accrualAsset.description: Amount recognised but not yet billed (contract asset) at period end.
accrualAsset.title: Accrual Asset

revenueWaterfallByContractPeriod.description: Declarative shape of the per-contract, per-period revenue roll-up RevenueCutoffService computes (REQ-IFRS15-008). Groups RevenueRecognitionEvent by (contractId, period) within an administration, sums recognisedAmount into periodRecognised, carries priorCumulativeRecognised from the prior period, derives cumulativeRecognised = priorCumulativeRecognised + periodRecognised and remainingAmount = transactionPriceAllocated - cumulativeRecognised, and forecasts the remaining amount forward over remainingMonths (60+, IFRS 15.120). contractGroupId enables group-level rollup for combination-of-contracts (REQ-IFRS15-011). When the OpenRegister aggregation engine cannot express the prior-period carry or the forward forecast, RevenueCutoffService computes the same result in PHP via the real ObjectService API.
